integration_decision.finding: New independent read of pinned executor infrastructure shows the failed role-identity task reached git diff --check only via if ok: commit_and_push. run_tests returns ok=True only after all listed pytest commands return zero. Therefore, conditional on the checked-out main executor source (confirmed at 4bbee3dfde71a90d8bbdc2a4c3def4bb3f195514 in job logs), the executor observed zero exit status for collect-only, targeted role integration, and full Capital Flow pytest on its temporary generated diff before git diff --check failed. This is a stronger execution-path inference than 'tests may not have run', but NOT an independently replayed PASS and NOT committed or current-HEAD regression coverage.
